layers.text: Camera: a single item sprite shown whole and centred on a transparent background, a slight three-quarter angle looking a little down, filling most of the square with a small margin, nothing cropped.

Faction: a pulp-magazine secret society of the 1920s, mock-sinister, silly and never scary. Their fixed colours: soft midnight indigo cloth shaded deeper violet-blue, never black; pale cream candle wax and parchment; small pieces of warm polished brass; and exactly one accent colour, a bright glowing spring green, only as small flames and glows: candle flames, lamp glass, an eye-in-a-spiral sign.

The item floats alone on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn behind or under it.

layers.text: Subject: one plain grey steel sword snapped in two in the middle, its two pieces apart, and two small spade-tipped deep-sea teal imp tails curling round the broken pieces from both sides; simple shapes and very few details.

There is only one sword, lying flat and snapped clean in two in the middle: the blade's tip lies apart from the hilt with a gap between them. The thin teal spade-tipped tail of a small imp curls round each piece. There is no creature in the image: only the broken sword and the two tails.
